interventions.detail: Used uv venv with Python 3.11 instead of conda env python=3.11.15
Installed CPU builds torch==2.7.1+cpu / torchvision==0.22.1+cpu from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
Removed cupy==13.6.0 from requirements.txt (CUDA-only, unused by worldrecon)
gsplat source builds (bundled gsplat_maskgaussian and git+gsplat) need CUDA_HOME; used PyPI gsplat JIT wheel instead
attention.py: made flash_attn import optional and fall back to F.scaled_dot_product_attention on CPU
apt install libgl1 libglib2.0-0t64 for opencv-python (libGL.so.1 missing)
skyseg.onnx is downloaded into the CWD at runtime; pre-fetched into repo root and env.sh cds there
